name: r1-oproj-cublaslt-forced-algo
author: solx-loop
description: The fused cublasLt call loses 7-15% to plain matmul mostly because reading the residual (C != D) slows the epilogue, not because of a wrong heuristic. The default L-band kernel (nvjet 128x256, cluster 2x2) suffers most. Forcing nvjet 128x192 2cta with a 2x1 cluster (tile 32, cluster id 3) at M >= 6144 recovers about 6-8% at L. Two S sizes gain about 8% from other heuristic entries. The M band is already on the best config.
